scope: Linux x64 ordinary Lean Std.Async.System.getHomeDir/getTmpDir and their UV primitives. Fifteen API comparisons per full and packaged engine, with separate retained oversized-HOME engine-startup failures. Not full-suite conformance.
repair: Share the POSIX temporary-directory selection between queries and creation; first present TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP/TEMPDIR including empty values, one trailing slash removed, raw bytes decoded by Lean, PATH_MAX checked before trimming. Home queries retain raw/empty HOME and use passwd fallback only when absent. Windows retains the previous adapter.
parallelProbe: The initial fifteen cases set variables before engine startup. Deno could not load npm configuration and local Bun panicked before reaching Lean for three oversized HOME cases. Startup.lean preserves the original program. Main.lean sets those three exact ASCII values with ordinary Lean osSetenv after startup; the other twelve inputs are unchanged. No upstream Lean test is changed. API passes do not count those bootstrap failures as passes.
